fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Spits a squirt that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Weakened] for 6 seconds. It also stuns the target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Reek
fusions.desc: Sprays a wide cone that deals 24 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit, and each hit has a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Foul Retort
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Not Twice
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
